core_meaning.primary_meaning: Selcuk is a Turkish-origin name meaning “Seljuk (Turkish tribal name)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Turkish word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Selcuk corresponds to the Turkish form سَلْجُوق (Turkish Selçuk (tribal name)). Its core sense is selcuk; seljuk (turkish tribal name). Selcuk is Turkish, the name of the Seljuk tribal founder. It is used as a male given name.

persian.name: سلجوق
